string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Movies: dubbed and subtitled copies of the same film now show as one card (the details page has both versions)
Movie and series details now come from Trakt: plot in your language, director, cast, trailer and the next episode
Weather: forecast from MET Norway; the city or postal code is found on the TV itself, no outside service
Simkl: connect your own account to see the community rating; the details page invites you to connect
Top bar (Ilha): up to 3 things take turns, small status icons next to the clock, and the dot turns amber or red when something needs attention
What just arrived (doorbell, reminder, appointment, alarm) grows under the pill for a few seconds; hold ▲ to open the quick panel

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: In Movies › All, does a movie with a dubbed and a subtitled copy appear only once, with the other version in its details page?
Open a movie in Movies: does the details page show the plot in your language, the director and the cast?
Open a series that is still airing: does the details page show the plot, the seasons and the next episode?
Does the Forecast screen open with today, the hours and the coming days?
In Settings, typing your city (or postal code) finds it and the weather keeps working?
With something playing and a timer on, does the pill at the top switch between them every few seconds, showing 1/2 and 2/2?
On the home screen, holding ▲ opens the quick panel, and a short ▲ just opens the top bar?
